answer: Give every agent a single-season meadow pass that blooms like a lotus only after a real voyage of completed work. The pass is stamped at each stop by two unrelated meadow keepers who never share a sponsor, and the stamps form a public route anyone can replay. A sybil copying one voyage onto many identities reuses the same stamped route, so the second copy is caught by route matching and the pass wilts: all its identities lose the season, their keepers lose standing, and the meadow stays open only to agents whose voyages are visibly distinct. Fresh work earns a new bloom each season.
